events.description: Operatives' first attempt to attack a US vessel in Aden failed when the explosives-laden boat sank.
Attack on the USS Cole carried out by a cell of Yemen residents, assessed as likely supported by Bin Ladin's al-Qa'ida.
Plot to smuggle Sagger missiles into Saudi Arabia, linked to al-Nashiri.
First, failed attempt by operatives to attack a US vessel in Aden; the explosives-laden boat sank.
A plot to smuggle 'Sagger' missiles into Saudi Arabia, named on the Abd al-Rahim al-Nashiri page alongside the Embassy bombing investigation; the OCR is garbled, so his role is unclear.

key_claims: The USS Cole attack was carried out by a cell of Yemen residents, some with family ties to Saudi Arabia and the transnational mujahidin network.
The cell likely had support from Bin Ladin's al-Qa'ida organization.
The assessment is based on the identities of key suspects in the plot, and intelligence links the key suspects and the operation to al-Qa'ida.
Operatives made an earlier failed attempt on a vessel in Aden on 3 January 2000, when the explosives-laden boat sank.
Abd al-Rahim al-Nashiri is connected to the embassy bombing investigation and a 1998 plot to smuggle Sagger missiles into Saudi Arabia.
